notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug that caused SWAT-related achievements to sometimes be unobtainable
-Fixed a bug that caused the solar panel to drop from the mattress box
-Fixed some localization errors

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
New Content:
-Added a sign that shows in which hours the store is open
-Added a jackhammer on construction site

Changes:
-Made colors in tutorial text more subdued
-Added a shopping cart to the tutorial
-Made bear trap deal more damage to enemies
-Made cave entrance bigger
-Made orange peel particles more soft
-Made tick deal less damage
-Increased tweezer uses
-Increased Barbamania discs HP
-Made "Halołyn" music disc easier to find
-Increased jackhammer damage to metal
-Slowed down SWAT officers


Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug that caused "Every dude collects scrap" achievement being unobtainable
-Fixed a bug that made jumping in dwarf mode not work correctly
-Fixed a bug that caused cars to be slippery
-Fixed a bug that caused some sound effects to not react to volume settings
-Fixed a bug that caused some sound effects not having 3D sound
-Fixed a bug that caused ticks not to have a sound effect on damaging player
-Fixed a bug that blocked camera rotation when standing on a cupboard
-Fixed a bug that caused solar panels and wind turbines to not count as scrap

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
WARNING!!!
This update made mouse rotation the default control scheme - from now on you need to press R to rotate an object by mouse, if you want to go back to old rotation controls, there is an checkbox for this in options.

New Features:
-Added a poster about ticks near the entrance of the store
-Added "Warning - Accidents" sign near the store and the junkyard
-Added controls info in the cooking section of the tutorial
-Added an indicator that mouse rotation is enabled

Changes:
-Removed a bush that partially obscured the altar of Barabasz
-Slightly slowed down cars
-Made mouse rotation the default control scheme

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug that made it impossible to sometimes drop items
-Fixed a bug that caused picking objects up to not work correctly after attempting to pick up certain objects
-Fixed a bug that caused mouse rotation to not work correctly
-Fixed a bug that caused the electricity tutorial video not to loop correctly

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
New Features:
-Added torn pages near the Altar of Barabasz with tips on how to find music disks needed for Barabasz's questline
-Added new energy drink "MEGAGrzmot"
-Made Tomasz visible inside his lair
-Added a pillow to the tutorial, to show players they can sleep on a pillow too
-Added a dialogue with Tomasz, that indicates that his questline was done correctly
-Added a pop up that warns players, while they get near the "hit by a car" cutscene

Changes:
-Moved UFO spawn point nearer the middle of the glade
-Changed the "skip to daytime" creative mode option, so that it skips now 5 seconds before daytime
-Adjusted language change button, for it to be more intuitive now

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a typo in Barabasz's dialogue
-Fixed a bug where the cash register hitbox blocked picking items up.
-Fixed a bug that made sleeping impossible in adventure mode
-Fixed a bug that inverted axes in mouse rotation mode
-Fixed a bug that made Skeleton Man bouncy
-Fixed bugged fences behind the store in creative mode

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
New Features:
-Added an information that you can't move glued items in the tutorial

Changes:
-Changed the position of "H-Help" text in the tutorial UI
-Slowed down mouse rotation control speed
-Increased the number of crime points for breaking ATM and the Slot Machine
-Significantly reduced electric shock damage
-Increased UFO spawn Chance
-Adjusted icicle form food hold offset

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New Features:
-Added "help" function, where you could re-read the tutorial texts at any point

Changes:
-Adjusted mouse sensitivity
-Improved tutorial texts
-Deleted longer tutorial descriptions, since they were found useless

Bug Fixes:
-Replaced $ with € in UI
-Fixes UI layer overlays

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
New Features:
-Added alternative object rotation controls
-Added an option to turn tutorial on and off once it is completed once
-Added an information in the tutorial that you cannot enquip an item when you are to close to wall to prevent items from clipping out of the map, since this feature was considered a bug.
-Added additional map borders on adventure mode, so there is no way to die by car accident out of bounds.

Changes:
-Removed physics rotation mode since except involountary rotation mode option on creative
-Made Gambling and Scrap achievements easier to obtain.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
New Changes:
-Added glue type items SFX on use
-Made cars destrooy items when they run over them
-Changed icons of stat bars, so they are more intuitve now
-Added a text that tells they player they are not tired enough to sleep
-Made bug spray legally distinct

Balance Adjustments:
-Reduced passenger HP
-Balanced crime points

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug where you could access a certain boss area earlier
